models.name: shopping_mall_system_configurations
models.description:
System configuration parameters and settings.

Stores key-value pairs representing global system behaviors, feature toggles, and operational parameters.
Configurations affect platform-wide features and can be edited by authorized administrators.

Each configuration has a unique key, a value string, a description, and temporal fields to track changes.
Soft delete supported to allow reversible disabling of settings.

plainFields.name: description

plainFields.name: updated_at

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: shopping_mall_categories
models.description:

models.name: shopping_mall_products
models.description:
Product entity representing items offered for sale in the shopping mall.

This table contains basic product information managed by sellers, including title, description, category reference, and brand details. Each product may have multiple variants (SKUs) represented in shopping_mall_product_variants. Soft delete functionality is supported via deleted_at. Products are linked to categories existing in the catalog domain.

Consistent temporal tracking is maintained via created_at and updated_at timestamps.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp; null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_variants
models.description:
Represents distinct SKUs (product variants) with unique combinations of attributes such as color, size, and options.

Each variant has its own inventory, pricing, and status independent of the parent product. The variant references its parent product and supports soft deletion. Detailed attributes allow for precise customer selection and inventory management.

This model enables the platform to handle complex product variant hierarchies consistently.

plainFields.name: updated_at

models.description:
Inventory records tracking SKU stock levels and availability.

Each inventory entry is associated with a specific product variant (SKU) and monitors stock quantities, reserved quantities, and restock dates. Supports soft deletion and temporal tracking for audit purposes.

models.name: shopping_mall_question_answers
models.description:
Answers provided by sellers in response to customer questions.

Each answer is linked to a specific customer question and created by an authenticated seller. This separation allows independent lifecycle management, including creation, updates, and soft deletion.

One-to-one relationship enforced by unique foreign key to the question.

Supports audit trails and enables efficient moderation of seller responses.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_question_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the customer question answered. {@link shopping_mall_customer_questions.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the seller who answered the question. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_session_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the seller's active session when providing the answer. {@link shopping_mall_seller_sessions.id}

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: The title or headline of the answer.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Detailed body text of the seller's answer.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the answer was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the answer was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the answer was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: shopping_mall_support_tickets
models.description:
Support tickets submitted by customers or sellers regarding various issues.

This entity tracks support requests including their status and handling workflow. Tickets are associated with the submitter, either customer or seller, and include session context.

Supports status management for ticket tracking, audit for responses, and soft deletion for moderation.

Enables customer support management and resolution tracking within the shopping mall platform.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the customer who submitted the ticket, if applicable. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the seller who submitted the ticket, if applicable. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_session_id
foreignFields.description: Customer session during ticket submission, if applicable. {@link shopping_mall_customer_sessions.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_session_id
foreignFields.description: Seller session during ticket submission, if applicable. {@link shopping_mall_seller_sessions.id}

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Subject or summary of the support ticket.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed explanation of the issue or request.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the ticket (e.g. open, in_progress, resolved, closed).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the ticket was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the ticket was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the ticket was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_audit_logs
models.description:
Administrator actions audit logs capturing detailed, immutable records of administrative operations for security, compliance, and traceability.

Each log entry records the acting admin, the type of action performed, affected resources, success or failure status, and timestamps. This facilitates forensic analysis and audit trails across the platform.

The model ensures historical integrity by disallowing updates or deletions of log entries.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the administrator who performed the action. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: The type of action performed by the admin (e.g., CREATE_USER, DELETE_PRODUCT).

plainFields.name: resource_type
plainFields.description: Type of resource affected by the action (e.g., user, product, order).

plainFields.name: resource_id
plainFields.description: Identifier of the affected resource, if applicable.

plainFields.name: success
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the action was successful.

plainFields.name: details
plainFields.description: Additional JSON-formatted details about the action for context and diagnostics.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the audit log entry was created.

models.name: shopping_mall_roles
models.description:
System roles defining sets of permissions for access control within the shopping mall platform.

Roles enable grouping of privileges and facilitate scalable management of user rights and administrative capabilities.

Roles have unique names and descriptive labels to clearly denote their purpose and scope.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Unique role identifier name used internally.

plainFields.name: label
plainFields.description: Human-readable label describing the role's purpose.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the role's permissions and context.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the role was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the role was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_user_roles
models.description:
Mapping of users to roles establishing user permissions within the shopping mall platform.

Each record indicates a specific role assigned to a user (administrator).

Supports the management of multiple roles per user and enables effective role-based access control.

Soft deletion allows temporary deactivation of role assignments without losing history.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the administrator user. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_role_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the role assigned. {@link shopping_mall_roles.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the role was assigned.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp to mark inactive role assignments.

models.name: shopping_mall_permissions
models.description:
Permissions defining granular access rights within the shopping mall backend.

Each permission entry includes a unique name, label, and detailed description.

Permissions are assigned to roles or users to enforce access control policies consistently and flexibly.

This enables fine-grained authorization across the platform's administrative functions.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Unique permission identifier for internal use.

plainFields.name: label
plainFields.description: Human-readable label describing the permission.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description about the scope and usage of the permission.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the permission was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the permission was last updated.

models.name: mv_shopping_mall_daily_sales
models.description:
Daily sales summary materialized view for the entire shopping mall platform.

Provides aggregated transactional sales data including total sales amounts, number of orders, and total items sold per day. This view enables fast analytics and reporting on daily performance trends, supporting business decision making and operational monitoring.

This table is automatically refreshed regularly and optimized for read-heavy queries. It is a read-only materialized view that denormalizes multiple transactional tables into a single snapshot for speed.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key unique to each daily sales summary record.

plainFields.name: sales_date
plainFields.description: The date representing the sales reporting day in ISO 8601 format.

plainFields.name: total_orders
plainFields.description: Total number of orders placed on the sales date.

plainFields.name: total_sales_amount
plainFields.description: Sum of all sales amounts (currency units) for the day.

plainFields.name: total_items_sold
plainFields.description: Total count of product items sold across all orders on that day.

models.name: mv_shopping_mall_inventory_status
models.description:
Current inventory status materialized view providing aggregated SKU inventory information across the entire mall.

This view consolidates inventory levels, low stock alerts, and SKU counts per product category to facilitate monitoring and stock management decisions. It enables efficient querying of inventory health and trends without requiring joins to multiple base tables.

As a materialized view, it is optimized for fast read operations and is periodically refreshed from transactional inventory data.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key unique to individual inventory status records.

plainFields.name: category_id
plainFields.description: Identifier of the product category this inventory summary record belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: total_sku_count
plainFields.description: Total number of distinct SKUs under the product category.

plainFields.name: total_inventory_quantity
plainFields.description: Aggregate quantity of all SKU items available in stock within the category.

plainFields.name: low_stock_threshold
plainFields.description: SKU inventory level considered low stock threshold for alerting.

plainFields.name: low_stock_sku_count
plainFields.description: Number of SKUs currently below the low stock threshold within this category.

plainFields.name: last_refreshed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this materialized view was last refreshed.
